pythonFunction.name: unlock_account
pythonFunction.description:
Unlocks a locked online account. The customer should wait before signing in again. Needs an
identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it
runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and wait_seconds.
